name: Request Share Held Date 1 Choice
definition: Choice between different ways of specifying the method to determine as from when shares have been held by an investor.

DateCalculationMethod.name: Date Calculation Method
DateCalculationMethod.definition: Indicates what is the logical method to be used to determine and communicate from which date the shares have been held.

DateCalculationDescription.name: Date Calculation Description
DateCalculationDescription.definition: Provides the description on how the date from which the shares have been held should be determined and communicated.
